module "M_FieldMap.dss"

product 0 Material "M_FieldMap" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0, 0), ParameterName="Colour", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L4:C1 "Colour"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L4:C1 "BaseColor"
  %2 = Constant(Value=(0.4)) : float @L9:C19 "Roughness"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L10:C37 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Multiply(%1, %3) : float3 @L10:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %5 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L11:C17 "Opacity"
  %6 = MaterialSink(BaseColor=%1, Roughness=%2, EmissiveColor=%4, Opacity=%5) @L6:C1
  sink %6
